# nanelo_record (Resource)

A single DNS record value.

Nanelo records have no IDs: a record is identified by its zone, name, type and value, and deleting it deletes every record with the same name, type and value. For that reason this resource refuses to create a record that already exists (import it instead), and two resources must never describe the same record.

Nanelo has no update operation, so changing `ttl` or `priority` deletes and re-adds the record, leaving a short window where it does not exist. Changing anything else replaces the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nanelo_record" "www" {
  name  = "www.example.org"
  type  = "A"
  value = "192.0.2.10"
  ttl   = 300
}

# The apex is addressed by the zone name itself.
resource "nanelo_record" "mx" {
  for_each = { "mx1.example.org." = 10, "mx2.example.org." = 20 }

  name     = "example.org"
  type     = "MX"
  value    = each.key
  priority = each.value
}

# SRV values are "<weight> <port> <target>"; the priority is separate.
resource "nanelo_record" "sip" {
  name     = "_sip._tcp.example.org"
  type     = "SRV"
  value    = "5 5060 sip.example.org."
  priority = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Fully-qualified record name, e.g. `www.example.org`. Use the zone name itself for the apex, and `*.example.org` for a wildcard.
- `type` (String) Record type. One of `A`, `AAAA`, `ALIAS`, `CAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `NS`, `PTR`, `SRV`, `TLSA`, `TXT`.
- `value` (String) Record value, stored verbatim. Hostnames are not normalized, so `target.example.org` and `target.example.org.` are different values. For `MX`, put the preference in `priority`. For `SRV`, use `<weight> <port> <target>` and put the priority in `priority`. TXT values are not quoted or split.

### Optional

- `priority` (Number) Priority for `MX` and `SRV` records. Defaults to `0`.
- `ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds. Nanelo only supports `60`, `300`, `900`, `1800`, `3600`, `7200`, `18000`, `43200`, `86400`. Defaults to `3600`.
- `zone` (String) Zone the record belongs to, e.g. `example.org`. Defaults to the provider's `zone`, or to the API key's only zone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<zone>/<name>/<type>/<value>`. Also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <zone>/<name>/<type>/<value>. The value may contain "/".
terraform import nanelo_record.www 'example.org/www.example.org/A/192.0.2.10'
```
